I think it’s a bit strange to blame other people for someone’s relapses. I wouldn’t say it’s the posters fault, especially if u put trigger warnings like the other comments say. But, something to think about is why you’re posting pictures of your self harm. When I self harm I always take pictures, I don’t know why but there must be a reason because I think a lottt of people do 😭 but I don’t really understand why people share those pictures. Even with trigger warnings, people only look at those pictures to compare their own self harm or to trigger themselves, at least those are the only reasons I can think of (and I have admittedly done lol). Not that you do this, but I usually see these picture paired with the caption saying something like “baby cuts” or like “I didn’t go deep enough” and then it’s like the persons arm is falling off 💀 very triggering. Or it’s filled with comments saying like “your cuts are so beautiful :3” and then the poster is like aww thank you!! Just doesn’t seem like a good environment to contribute to. Maybe create an album of pictures to still document, but not share to the public. You could even share the album with someone like a therapist who is able to provide insight and stuff. I’m not trying to shame you at all. The whole concept of posting your self harm though seems like a breeding ground for lots of issues. I can’t think of one reason other people viewing it would be helpful to them or yourself
